quotes.quote: Validation losses rapidly converged within 20,000–40,000 training iterations, resulting in a relatively high F1 score (0.91) for Cell 1 and

specification.comparison_metric: F1 score computed as harmonic mean of precision and recall, comparing predicted binary segmentation to ground-truth annotations.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: F1 score must match the reported value 0.91 within the displayed rounding bin (two decimal places).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact train/validation split, the specific validation block used, the random seed, and the exact data augmentation parameters are not fully specified in the text; the ground truth annotation details are in Table S4 which is not in the deposit listing.
